finding.headline: The document is not a local addendum. It is an Illinois Supreme Court approved statewide standardized form whose own first printed line says every Illinois Circuit Court is required to accept it. The recorded role local_addendum is wrong on both axes at once: the scope is statewide rather than local, and the role is a filed notice rather than an addendum.
finding.acquisitionRequiredRationale: Nothing needs to be obtained. The binary is retained, the dependency job already confirmed it byte-identical to the issuer's published copy, and the defect is a recorded role and scope, not a missing file.

resolvedIdentity.repositoryIdentityDefect: The CXP prefix is a filename fragment on the Illinois Courts CDN, not a published form number. The dependency job established that the official index HTML contains no form-number tokens at all and that the real numbers are printed only in the PDF footers under different prefixes.

resolvedIdentity.officialTitleEvidence: The printed caption block reads 'NOTICE OF COURT DATE FOR MOTION TO VACATE & EXPUNGE ELIGIBLE CANNABIS CONVICTIONS'. The document-information /Title independently reads 'Illinois Standardized Forms - Approved - Notice of Court Date for Motion to Vacate & Expunge Eligible Cannabis Convictions'.
resolvedIdentity.issuer: Illinois Supreme Court, approved standardized form developed by the Supreme Court Commission on Access to Justice
resolvedIdentity.issuerEvidence: The document-information /Author reads 'Commission on Access to Justice', and the first printed line attributes approval to the Illinois Supreme Court.
resolvedIdentity.revisionEvidence: Printed in the footer of both pages beside the form number and the page count.
resolvedIdentity.currentnessDetail: The dependency job retrieved the issuer's published copy at HTTP 200 on its own retrieval date and found it byte-identical to the held copy. This job re-measured the held copy and reproduced the same digest. Currentness is asserted as of that retrieval, not as of a reading taken today, because this assignment forbids downloading.
resolvedIdentity.roleDetail: A notice served on the State's Attorney informing them of the court date set on the petitioner's Motion to Vacate & Expunge. It is a filed, served document in its own right — not an addendum to another document, and not a local supplement.
resolvedIdentity.servedOn: the county State's Attorney who prosecuted the cases
resolvedIdentity.servedOnEvidence: Item 2 of the face reads 'To: ______ County State's Attorney' with a street address, city, state and ZIP block, and the printed instruction column notes that this contact information is publicly available online or from the county Circuit Clerk.
resolvedIdentity.scopeBasis: Not inferred from a service address or a venue selector. The document's own first printed line, set above the caption, reads verbatim: 'This form is approved by the Illinois Supreme Court and is required to be accepted in all Illinois Circuit Courts.' That is a statement of mandatory statewide acceptance printed by the issuer on the artifact.
resolvedIdentity.mandatoryAcceptanceVerbatim: This form is approved by the Illinois Supreme Court and is required to be accepted in all Illinois Circuit Courts.
resolvedIdentity.mandatoryAcceptanceDistinction: The line mandates acceptance by every Circuit Court. It is not on its face a statement that a petitioner must use this form rather than another. The distinction is preserved rather than collapsed: what is established is that no Illinois Circuit Court may refuse it, which is the precise opposite of a local addendum.

twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.recorded: local — the role name local_addendum asserts a county or circuit-specific document
twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.measured: statewide, by the issuer's own printed acceptance line
twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.consequence: A local_addendum role would ordinarily bar a document from statewide promotion. Here it would suppress a form the Illinois Supreme Court requires every Circuit Court to accept.

twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.recorded: addendum — a supplement appended to another document
twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.measured: notice — an independently filed and served instrument with its own caption, its own two-page body, its own service block and its own form number
twoSeparateErrorsInOneLabel.consequence: An addendum is assembled onto a parent; a notice is filed and served. Modelling this as an addendum would attach it to the Motion instead of serving it on the State's Attorney, which is the one thing the document exists to do.

whyTheLocalAddendumLabelIsWrong.notAPhantom: Unlike identities resolved elsewhere in this programme that named no document at all, this identity names a real, current, retained, statewide-approved form. The defect is entirely in how it is labelled.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: the document, issuer, title, printed form number, revision, role and scope are all established from the artifact. It is not acquisition_required: the bytes are held and were confirmed against the issuer by the completed dependency. It is not a phantom: the document is real, current and statewide-approved. What is wrong is a two-part label, and both parts are wrong in the same direction — they understate the document's standing.

expectedDownstreamEffect: One Illinois source identity moves from a local_addendum label with a null title and an unconfirmed revision to a fully identified statewide Illinois Supreme Court approved notice with a printed form number, a printed revision, a measured structure and a pinned digest. The sole remaining open dependency of three blocked Illinois implementation jobs is answered. Edition 1.3 receives a complete new row requiring no acquisition. The CXP filename-fragment defect is recorded once more with the printed EXC-N number supplied. No component is rebound, no unrelated route design is touched, no receipt is created, no binary enters version control, no renderer is assigned, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
